project-identity

Show the project identity resolved from the current workspace.

Usage:
  agent-issues project-identity

Options:
  --db <path> | Use a specific SQLite database path.
  --json | Print machine-readable JSON. Entity mutations return acknowledgements; list and relation reads return summaries.
  --pretty | Pretty-print JSON when used with --json.
  --help, -h | Show help for the whole CLI or the selected command.

Examples:
  agent-issues project-identity
  agent-issues project-identity --json

Notes:
  Resolution precedence is environment override, .agent-issues.json file, Git remote name, package.json name, then folder name.

Output:
  Human-readable:
    Resolved project identity and its source
  JSON fields:
    command
    identity
    source
